item.title: Head of Events and Experiences
item.description:
• Benchmarking Code: - JOB091
  • Function: - Marketing & PR
  • Location: - London
  • Contract Type: - Permanent
  • Salary Details: - £Competitive + Bonus + Benefits
  • About The Role: -

    Team – Events

    Working pattern - Hybrid – 2 days a week in the London office. Full time, 37.5 hours a week. 

    Flexible working is always up for discussion.

    Three things we look for:

    • A record of running a large events programme and shaping its strategy
    • A fresh, inventive eye for member experiences
    • Curiosity about how new technology changes live events

    You will lead a small team and report to the Marketing Director.
